result.title: Beyond Semantic IDs: Atomic Creator Tokens for Large-Scale Generative Recommendation
result.summary: Recommending creators that a user does not yet follow is a cold-start problem: from hundreds of thousands of popular creators and only a short trail of prior engagements, the system must predict the next creator worth surfacing. The prevailing generative recommendation recipe tokenizes each creator into a \emph{Semantic ID} (SID) by quantizing a frozen embedding and trains a language model to generate SIDs. We show that this SID layer, not the language model, is the binding constraint. The creator-to-SID map is many-to-one, so colliding creators must be resolved by a popularity tie-break that caps creator-level recall and favors already-popular creators, and the frozen quantizer stops the training gradient from reaching the creator representation. We propose Atomic Creator Token (ACT), which gives every creator its own vocabulary token trained end-to-end. The map is bijective, so collisions are impossible and inference is a direct top-$k$ over creator logits. In a controlled comparison on production data in which the token layer is the only variable, ACT improves creator-level Recall@15 by 19.8 points ($1.84\times$) over a matched SID baseline, still leads when the SID codebook is enlarged $64\times$, and serves at ${\sim}2.7\times$ lower per-user latency. The advantage carries over to the public KuaiRand dataset, where ACT is the only method that beats a global-popularity baseline, provided each creator token sees enough training examples. In a live A/B test, ACT is directionally positive on every reported metric against both the SID-enhanced and the classic production rankers.

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究生成式推荐的创作者 tokenization，指出 Semantic ID 的量化层是多对一映射与性能瓶颈，提出为每个创作者分配独立词表 token 并端到端训练的 Atomic Creator Token，在生产数据和公开数据集上提升召回并降低延迟。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「多对一量化导致碰撞、冻结量化器阻断梯度回传到表示」的论证，可能为 LVR 中离散视觉/latent token 的信息坍缩与端到端训练权衡提供类比，但领域距离较远，仅可供核查。
